title: Bank of England Raises Bank Rate to 4% in 8–1 Vote as CPI Inflation Seen Near 5% in 2027
detail: The Monetary Policy Committee voted 8–1 at its meeting ending 4 November 2026 to raise Bank Rate by 0.25 points to 4%; one member wanted a 0.5-point rise to 4.25%. The November Monetary Policy Report, published 5 November, put CPI inflation at 3.5% in September (2.6% in June) and projected it to rise to around 5% by mid-2027 before falling back toward the 2% target, while saying activity had been more resilient than expected since July.
